thread:
Jordan: Heads up — vendor CloudBridge rejected our PO upload in the marketplace portal. Error = "missing taxSplit". Customer (ACME Corp) is waiting to go live next week, procurement is blocked. Anyone from finance/ops own this flow?
Marta: :eyes: which exporter produces the marketplace JSON? @Trevor?
Trevor: that's eng-infra. Our export uses the legacy PO schema (single tax_code on header). portal validation now requires per-line taxSplit.
Ajay: Finance here. CloudBridge needs a taxSplit array per line, example they expect:
```json
{"po_number":"PO-12345","items":[{"lineId":"1","amount":100.00,"taxSplit":[{"taxCode":"US-SALES","amount":7.5}]}]}
```
We currently emit:
```json
{"po_number":"PO-12345","tax_code":"US-SALES","items":[{"lineId":"1","amount":100.00}]}
```
Attachments won't satisfy their JSON schema validation.
Liz: Revenue ops — this is sticky because legal already redlined their marketplace terms for net-30. Vendor says they won't accept the order until PO passes schema. Manual invoice flow would push go-live by >1 week.
Marta: can we get a waiver while we fix the exporter? @Sarah can you escalate to the vendor contact?
Sarah: pinged vendor contact (cc'ed). They asked for a signed amendment to accept manual uploads. Asked if we can provide a short-term workaround.
Henry (Legal): I can draft a one-page amendment for manual invoice acceptance. Need the exact interim process spelled out (who receives invoices, payment terms, and liability language). Can do same-day review if you send draft.
Trevor: technically I can add a taxSplit mapper: map header tax_code -> per-line taxSplit totals. Quick patch path:
- add taxSplit array with one entry per line using header tax_code
- bump schema version in exporter
Estimated T+2 business days for patch + smoke tests. I can try to push an emergency hotfix in 24-48hrs if we accept limited QA.
Ajay: If we do hotfix, finance needs to sign-off on how amounts round and how we represent VAT vs sales tax. Also, we'll need a reconciliation script to ensure AR matches PO.
Marta: Plan proposal:
1) Trevor attempts 48hr hotfix to emit taxSplit totals (limited QA)
2) Sarah secures vendor provisional acceptance for manual upload or to accept patched schema
3) Henry drafts 1-page amendment in parallel
4) Ajay prepares reconciliation checklist + manual invoice fallback
Jordan: I'm ok with that plan. Customer update ready once Sarah confirms vendor. Please post status updates here. :pray:
Sarah: vendor replied — they will accept manual upload for this single PO if we sign the amendment. Asked for ETA on patch as well.
Trevor: starting branch now. If hit blocker I'll call infra oncall. Will post PR when ready for review.
Henry (Legal): draft sent to Sarah via DocuSign link. If vendor signs we'll route amendment through partners legal queue.
Ajay: prepping manual invoice SOP. Will need PO PDF + signed amendment + charge codes from revenue ops.
Liz: I'll hold the go-live until we get either vendor acceptance or successful schema validation. Keeping customer in loop.
Jordan: thanks all. Tagging this for escalation to deal-desk: @deal-desk — procurement blocked on marketplace schema; workaround in progress, ETA 48hrs for patch, amendment route available.
Deal Desk: acknowledged. We'll pause any auto-closure on procurement ticket and help coordinate vendor acceptance. :thumbsup:
Trevor: PR opened: github.com/redwood/integrations/+/4321 — adding taxSplit mapping. Running CI now.
Sarah: vendor signed amendment electronically. Sending confirmation to Ajay + Liz.
Ajay: received amendment, starting manual invoice process for PO-12345. Will follow reconciliation checklist.
Jordan: great. I'll close this thread once patch is in prod and customer confirmed go-live. Thanks everyone. :tada:
